build_PQ_quantizer: build a PQ quantizer for neural network layer weights using product quantization with k-means clustering
encode_PQ_centroids: encode neural network weights into centroids and assignments using the PQ encode method with k-means
decode_PQ_weights: decode quantized centroids and assignments back into the original weight matrix using the PQ decode method
determine_PQ_block_size: determine the optimal block size for product quantization based on weight matrix shape and max block size
reshape_and_split_PQ: reshape and split weight tensors into subvectors for product quantization across multiple codebooks
